text:
jess_prod: OK team — final pass on Hosted/Dedicated/Private landing copy before next week's push. Need four deliverables: launch post outline, benchmark narrative for the blog, webinar plan + RSVP funnel, and inbound lead routing rules. Quick sync?

marco_growth: On it. I'll draft the launch post and benchmark narrative. Can we call out measured latency + cost numbers? Thinking band: ~20–40% lower per-token cost vs our previous baseline (conservative).

anya_content: I can fold that into hero/headlines. Suggest distinct hero hooks per mode: Hosted = "Get up and running in minutes", Dedicated = "Predictable throughput, reserved GPUs", Private = "Control and compliance for regulated workloads". Keep voice short + benefit-first.

ryan_design: I'll sketch page layouts. Need CTA hierarchy for each mode. Hosted top CTA: `Try the API` (free credits). Dedicated: `Contact Sales` (SLA/commit messaging). Private: `Request Security Brief / Demo`. Also will add trust badges and region callouts.

beth_ops: For inbound routing, prefer rules based on intent and region. High-usage/org-size -> Dedicated; regulated keywords -> Private. I can convert to HubSpot workflow after we agree on tags.

marco_growth: Draft benchmark narrative notes: show p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and one real-app case (conversational search) as a small vignette. Include a clear methodology appendix (hardware, sequence lengths, batch settings) so claims are verifiable.

jess_prod: Perfect. For the webinar — title idea: "Serving LLMs in Production: Cost, Latency, and Compliance". Format: 45m talk + 15m Q&A, demo + customer panel.

anya_content: Length + format sounds good. Panel suggestion: infra eng, product PM, and a customer (preferably financial or healthcare). Slide flow: 1) problem, 2) approach (runtime + routing), 3) benchmark results, 4) live demo, 5) roadmap + Q&A.

ryan_design: For the demo: live call to Hosted, then show a graceful failover to a Dedicated/Private variant to demonstrate routing & fallback. Need a short script and pre-record fallback as backup.

beth_ops: Proposed inbound routing rules (high-level) — will implement in HubSpot workflows once approved:

```
# inbound routing pseudocode
if lead.company_size >= 200 and intent_tags contains 'throughput' -> assign: sales-dedicated
elif intent_tags contains 'compliance' or lead.region in ['eu','apac'] -> assign: sales-private
elif lead.trial_status == 'active' and lead.used_api_calls > 0 -> assign: growth-nurture
else -> assign: marketing-inbound
```

beth_ops: Also recommend lead enrichment step (clearbit) to detect vertical and org size before routing.

marco_growth: For landing microcopy in the benchmarks section: short line + CTA. Example: "Benchmarked on 8x A100; see methodology" -> link to appendix. Keep the numbers conservative and link to raw results.

jess_prod: Action items + deadlines: Marco - first draft of launch post + benchmark doc by Tue EOD. Anya - hero variants and 3 headline options by Tue. Ryan - CTAs + demo script + pre-record by Wed. Beth - hubspot workflow stubs + routing rule doc by Wed. I'll schedule the webinar for Thu next week and invite panelists. Sync: Thu 10am for dry-run. @ryan_design can you take the slot?

ryan_design: Yep — calendar invite sent.

anya_content: Small copy note: keep shared value props consistent across mode pages — same benefit language, swap CTAs/trust elements per mode. Use a single customer quote placeholder across drafts.

marco_growth: I'll add a small "how we measure" appendix to the benchmark doc with a conservative numbers table and reproducibility notes.

jess_prod: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll do a final proof and send to legal for claims check before publishing. If anything blocks, drop it here and we'll triage.
